title: FetchMark - Save & Summarize Any Article
excerpt: FetchMark turns any article URL into a clean summary
content_html:
✨ Join the Open Beta

FetchMark - The Bookmark Manager That Never Loses Pages

FetchMark is currently in Open Beta. Create a free account today to get instant, unrestricted access to all Pro features—including unlimited archiving and markdown exports. No credit card required.

How it works

Free tier · No credit card

How it works

Three quiet steps between a link and lasting knowledge.

01

Paste a link

Drop any URL into the composer. Articles, essays, docs, job posts — anything you'd otherwise lose.

02

We archive it

FetchMark fetches the page, strips ads, nav, and trackers, and stores a clean, permanent copy in your library.

03

Read forever

Return to a distraction-free Reader view. Even if the original goes offline, your archived copy remains.

“The average bookmark you save today has a 50% chance of being broken within a decade.”

Built for readers, not collectors

A small set of tools, chosen carefully.

Questions

Small print, plainly said.

What happens if the original page goes offline?
Your archived copy stays in your library. FetchMark stores the clean text of the page, so the words remain even when the URL doesn't.

Is my library private?
Yes. Every article, highlight and note is scoped to your account and protected by row-level security.

Can I get my data out?
Any time. Export any article to Markdown from the Reader view — no lock-in.

How much does it cost?
Nothing during the Open Beta — every account gets unrestricted access to all Pro features free of charge while we fine-tune the platform.

✨ Open Beta Tier

$0

Throughout Beta Phase

Help us test the future of bookmarking. Enjoy total ad-free reading and unlimited library saves completely free while we fine-tune the platform.

Join the Open Beta

When the Open Beta concludes, you will automatically transition to our generous standard Free tier. Your saved data will remain 100% safe.
